rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The allowable rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: The security deposit interest rate is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: Rent Board 572 Security Deposit Interest Rates

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation, relocation of $8,245.00 per tenant is due, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 per elderly or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use, Temporary Capital Improvement Work, or Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 instead.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Ellis Act Relocation Payments
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, relocation of $11,110.05 per tenant is due, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; maximum $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 per elderly or disabled tenant
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Under 20 Days
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days with notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, relocation of $446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses) is due per tenant household.
rules.key_value: $446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses) per tenant household
rules.coverage_text: Tenants temporarily displaced for less than 20 days for capital improvement work
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
